description.en: Galilee and the coast from Acre, with Beirut and Tripoli; 'control of most of Palestine' (Britannica).
description.ar: الجليل والساحل من عكا، مع بيروت وطرابلس؛ 'control of most of Palestine' [السيطرة على معظم فلسطين] (بريتانيكا).
description.he: הגליל והחוף מעכו, עם ביירות וטריפולי; “control of most of Palestine” [שליטה ברוב פלשתינה] (בריטניקה).

sources.quote: was appointed governor of the Saida province in return for his services. Using Akka as his seat and power base, he quickly brought not only Beirut but also Tripoli under his direct rule.
Aḥmad al-Jazzār, the Ottoman governor of Acre, had control of most of Palestine, and in 1799, with English and Ottoman help, he successfully defended Acre against Napoleon I.
the glory he earned by successfully defending Akka against Bonaparte's powerful army in 1799

notes.en: Extent of control over central and southern Palestine is schematic.
notes.ar: امتداد السيطرة على وسط فلسطين وجنوبها تخطيطي.
notes.he: היקף השליטה במרכז פלשתינה ובדרומה סכמטי.
